_rules: Variables: {first_name} {hook} {context} {proof} {offer} {sender}. {hook} is ONE true sentence Cowork writes from the live profile (role, post, company news) or empty.
Touch 1: under ~60 words, no links, one interest question (Gong Labs: interest CTAs ~2x meeting asks on cold outreach).
Touch 2: add value or proof. Touch 3: short, easy out, or a referral ask.
Variants a/b are A/B tested automatically (Thompson sampling on reply rate). Add c, d... to test more.
